subject: A user confession that stopped me cold last week
preview_text: I got a message that changed how I think about this app. It wasn't about features or bugs. It was about a mistake.
body_paragraphs: Last Tuesday, a user named Sarah sent me a message. Just a few sentences. I read it standing in my kitchen, and I had to sit down. She told me she'd been using SoulPlan to plan surprise dates for her husband. But last month, she stopped.

She said she got busy. Life happened. Then last week, her husband sat her down and asked if she was okay. He said the dates weren't about the activities or the restaurants. He missed the feeling of being surprised. Of knowing she was still thinking about him, plotting something just for them. She cried when she told me. I'm not going to lie—I got a little choked up too.

That's the thing about the Surprise Date Planner feature. It's not just a tool. It's a signal. A little flag you plant that says 'I'm still here, thinking about us.' Even when life gets loud. Especially when life gets loud.

Open the app right now. Tap the Surprise tab. Pick one thing—just one—for this weekend. Don't overthink it. The magic isn't in the perfect plan. It's in the act of planning. P.S. Sarah told me she planned a simple picnic surprise after she wrote me. She said his smile when he figured it out was the same as their first date.
